T: Vengeance in the rain. Stew by the fire.
D: In his second year as Batman, Bruce follows a serial killer's riddles into Gotham's corruption.
P: Serve the snacks when Batman and Gordon walk into the Iceberg Lounge.
S: Smoked salmon on rye with crème fraîche, and spicy marinated olives with orange peel, served on black slate.
Pretzel dough shaped into question marks, boiled in bicarb water, rock salt on top, baked at 220C for 12 minutes.
Selina Kyle and the cats in her apartment
Canned tuna mashed with potato, spring onion and lemon, shaped into small cakes, crumbed and pan-fried until golden, with sriracha mayo.
M: Beef chuck browned and simmered 3 hours with stout, onion and thyme, served over buttery mash.
Alfred keeping Bruce going in the old Wayne Tower
Roast chicken with lemon and herbs, with roast potatoes and a pan gravy, the meal Bruce keeps skipping.
W: the sea wall breaking and flooding Gotham
Dark chocolate melted into hot cream, whisked with yolks and sugar, set in small glasses for 4 hours, topped with whipped cream and crushed honeycomb.
K: Vodka, coffee liqueur and fresh espresso shaken hard for a frothy top. Iced coffee for those not drinking.

s.how: Cut 4 slices rye into small squares and spread with creme fraiche. Top each with a fold of smoked salmon. Warm the olives in a pan with strips of orange peel and a pinch of chilli flakes for 3 minutes, then serve both on a dark board.

Mix 500g flour, 7g yeast, a pinch of sugar and 300ml warm water into a dough and rest an hour. Roll into ropes and shape into question marks. Dip in boiling water with 2 tbsp bicarb soda, sprinkle with rock salt and bake at 220C for 12 minutes.

m.how: Brown 1kg diced beef chuck in batches. Add 2 sliced onions and soften, then pour in 375ml stout and enough water to cover. Add thyme, cover and simmer gently for 3 hours until tender. Boil 1kg potatoes, mash with plenty of butter and serve the stew on top.

w.note: the sea wall breaking and flooding Gotham
w.how: Heat 300ml cream until steaming and pour over 200g chopped dark chocolate. Whisk 3 yolks with 50g sugar and stir through until glossy. Pour into 4 small glasses and chill for 4 hours. Top with whipped cream and a scatter of crushed honeycomb just before serving.

d.how: Shake 45ml vodka, 20ml coffee liqueur and 30ml cooled espresso hard with ice. Strain into 4 chilled coupes and top each with 3 coffee beans.
